title: OpenAI is opening its ChatGPT ad platform to all U.S. businesses with self-serve buying

facts.fact: OpenAI eliminated the $50,000 entry barrier that had restricted its ChatGPT ad platform's self-serve Ads Manager to larger spenders, opening it to all U.S. businesses.
facts.quote: after the company eliminated the $50,000 entry barrier that had restricted the platform to larger spenders since its debut earlier this year

facts.fact: The ChatGPT ad platform launched in February 2026 with a small group of test partners and a cost-per-thousand-impressions pricing model.
facts.quote: a platform that launched in February 2026 with a small group of test partners and a cost-per-thousand-impressions pricing model

facts.fact: Advertisers on OpenAI's ChatGPT ad platform can now also buy on a cost-per-click basis, according to Axios as cited by Quartz.
facts.quote: Advertisers can now also buy on a cost-per-click basis

facts.fact: Cost-per-click bids on ChatGPT ads were set between $3 and $5 per click for pilot advertisers.
facts.quote: with bids set between $3 and $5 per click

facts.fact: The cost per thousand impressions for ChatGPT ads fell from an opening rate of $60 to about $25 in some transactions.
facts.quote: the cost per thousand impressions had fallen from an opening rate of $60 to about $25 in some transactions

facts.fact: The minimum campaign commitment for ChatGPT ads dropped from $250,000 to $50,000.
facts.quote: the minimum campaign commitment had already dropped from $250,000 to $50,000

facts.fact: According to Axios, OpenAI is targeting $2.5 billion in advertising revenue for the current year.
facts.quote: Axios reports that OpenAI is targeting $2.5 billion in advertising revenue for the current year

facts.fact: According to Axios, OpenAI has a longer-range ambition of reaching $100 billion in advertising revenue by 2030.
facts.quote: with a longer-range ambition of reaching $100 billion by 2030

facts.fact: OpenAI's conversions pixel for ChatGPT ads is already live, and a conversions API is in development.
facts.quote: A conversions pixel is already live, and a conversions API is in development.

facts.fact: According to Digiday, OpenAI's ads lead said cost-per-action bidding and third-party measurement are forthcoming, but he declined to specify when either would arrive.
facts.quote: two forthcoming additions — cost-per-action bidding and third-party measurement — while declining to specify when either would arrive

facts.fact: Category eligibility for ChatGPT ads is currently narrow, with consumer goods, local services, travel, entertainment, and digital or educational products among the permitted categories.
facts.quote: consumer goods, local services, travel, entertainment, and digital or educational products are among those permitted

facts.fact: Ad placement inside ChatGPT remains entirely under OpenAI's control, while ad tech partners manage only budgets, bids, and creative assets.
facts.quote: Where ads actually appear inside ChatGPT remains entirely under OpenAI's control

facts.fact: Advertisers on ChatGPT receive rolled-up performance figures rather than access to the raw conversation data behind a placement.
facts.quote: Rather than gaining access to the raw conversation data behind any given placement, advertisers are given rolled-up performance figures.

facts.fact: Agency holding companies Dentsu, Omnicom, Publicis, and WPP are among those gaining access to OpenAI's self-serve ChatGPT ad platform.
facts.quote: Agency holding companies Dentsu, Omnicom, Publicis, and WPP are among those gaining access

facts.fact: Ad tech firms Criteo, Kargo, Pacvue, and StackAdapt will also have access to OpenAI's ChatGPT ad platform, as will Adobe.
facts.quote: Criteo, Kargo, Pacvue, and StackAdapt will also have access to the platform.
